steps.en: PLUS can permanently suspend a paid notice with a waiver, cancel or similar reason
steps.id: PLUS bisa mem-permanent-suspend notice yang sudah dibayar dengan alasan waiver, cancel, dan sejenisnya

steps.en: A refund record is created for the paid notice with its amount and reason
steps.id: Catatan refund dibuat untuk notice berbayar lengkap dengan jumlah dan alasannya

steps.en: The refund advice is sent on to Cumulus
steps.why_en: No link to Cumulus exists; the refund record only stays inside OCMS.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada hubungan ke Cumulus; catatan refund hanya tersimpan di dalam OCMS.

steps.en: Staff see the refund in a daily and monthly exception report
steps.id: Staf melihat refund di laporan exception harian dan bulanan
steps.why_en: Report email is switched off in the production settings in the repo.
steps.why_id: Email laporan dimatikan di pengaturan produksi yang ada di repo.
